Target document: Monthly Tables (under [https://www.cbaruba.org/document/monthly-tables-YYYY](https://www.cbaruba.org/document/monthly-tables-YYYY)). Target table: 'TABLE 2: COMPONENTS OF BROAD MONEY' (page 4). FCD is calculated as Col(5) [Demand deposits - Foreign currency] + Col(9) [Other deposits - Savings - Foreign currency] + Col(11) [Other deposits - Time - Foreign currency]. Total Deposits (TD) is calculated as Col(6) [Demand deposits - Total] + Col(12) [Other deposits - Total]. Header Forward Fill (ffill) is required due to merged header cells.
